excluded.name: Cayuse, Umatilla and Walla Walla
excluded.why: its polygon on Native Land's map spans 124.8 W to 104.6 W and 38.6 N to 50.1 N, most of the American West, far past the Cayuse, Umatilla and Walla Walla homelands on the Columbia Plateau (a drawing error in their data; it named the Sierra foothills, the Olympic coast, the Tetons and Lamar)
